limitations.claim: candidate-level experience stratification impossible from stored data
evidence: probe/stage2/stage3 per-day match records store COUNTS only (n_cand/n_above/n_below...); no per-candidate rows for below-floor candidates
per-candidate pair ids + scores exist ONLY for SELECTED pairs (key 'selected_scored'); below-floor candidates are a count (n_below) with no ids/scores/experience
no stored key anywhere contains 'hist_', 'experience', 'prior_intro' or member-history fields for candidates
schema_discovery in this file lists the exact stored keys
limitations.consequence: the required 'history available at candidate decision time' stratification (0/1-2/3+ prior intros per feasible candidate) cannot be computed without NEW simulator runs, which this stage does not perform; reported as STOP for that sub-part
limitations.proxy_used: variant identity (cold_start) and decision-day buckets (early days = low accumulated history) are reported as explicitly-labeled proxies only
